note.text: A protection mechanism failure vulnerability (CWE-693) resulting in improperly limiting pathname to a restricted directory in FortiPortal may allow an authenticated attacker to perform a path traversal attack via maliciously crafted GET parameters.
note.title: Summary

note.text: FortiPortal versions 5.2.5 and below.FortiPortal versions 5.3.5 and below.FortiPortal versions 6.0.4 and below.
note.title: Affected Products

note.text: Please upgrade to FortiPortal version 5.2.6 or above.Please upgrade to FortiPortal version 5.3.6 or above.Please upgrade to FortiPortal version 6.0.5 or above.
note.title: Solutions

acknowledgment.description: Fortinet is pleased to thank Ben Knight for reporting this issue under responsible disclosure.
